neighbours.label: the piece ' pre' where the tokenizer splits it off a longer word (pre|front|al, pre|war, pre|existing), as opposed to the same stems with another prefix or none
fire: The town's prewar houses still line the river.
She has a preexisting heart condition, her doctor said.
They found prehistoric tools at the back of the cave.
The shop sells clothes for her preteen daughter.
We were preapproved for the loan last week.
Damage to the prefrontal cortex can change behaviour.
He watched the prequel with his brother on Sunday.
Use the prewash cycle for very muddy clothes.
quiet: The town's postwar houses still line the river.
She has an existing heart condition, her doctor said.
They found historic tools at the back of the cave.
The shop sells clothes for her teenage daughter.
We were approved for the loan last week.
Damage to the subfrontal cortex can change behaviour.
He watched the sequel with his brother on Sunday.
Use the rewash cycle for very muddy clothes.

short: ' pre' as its own piece of a longer word
notes: Card: ' pre' x16, 'Pre' x3, ' Pre' x3, ' prec' x2, 'pre' x2. Probes: ' pre' 0.37-0.96 on prefrontal, preheated, preadolescent, preloaded and on the bare word; prenatal and prefabricated tokenize differently (' prenatal', ' pref') and stay under 0.01. ' post' 0.08, ' super' 0.01. 'Pre' and capitals fire too (0.36-0.87) but are not tested here. Pieces checked with the tokenizer.
